meta.title: A classic event's detail page exposes the same lifecycle controls
gaps: Verify these controls specifically on a classic single-stage event: the fixed prepared RFQ fixture does not establish that event type, and replacing it is not allowed.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Verify these controls specifically on a classic single-stage event: the fixed prepared RFQ fixture does not establish that event type, and replacing it is not allowed.

steps.note: Open the existing prepared event at the required starting screen.
Assert Master QCS resolves and renders the comparison grid with the line item and bidding vendor.
Follow the stage's bids entry point.
Assert the Responses route resolves and its screen is ready.
Open the published stage's Participants list.
Assert the Participants route resolves and its screen is ready.
Open the published event's Settings menu.
Assert Settings actually opens and exposes a lifecycle action.
